hints.title: Suffix Apple Counts
hints.text: Precompute apples[r][c], the count of apples in the rectangular piece from (r, c) to bottom-right (R - 1, C - 1).

hints.title: Horizontal and Vertical Cuts
hints.text: A horizontal cut at row nr is valid if top slice has apples (apples[r][c] - apples[nr][c] > 0) and bottom slice has apples (apples[nr][c] >= remaining cuts).

hints.title: State Transition with Modulo
hints.text: State is (r, c, remaining_cuts). Sum ways across all valid horizontal and vertical cuts modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing apple counts repeatedly across overlapping slices causes combinatorial timeout.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 2D suffix sums provide O(1) apple checks for each candidate cut position.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses 2D suffix sums and 3D state table (r, c, k) with modulo accumulation.
complexity.notes: Each piece must contain at least one apple.

solutions.approach: suffix 2D prefix sums with 3D recursive state memorization
